d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Uttar Ramayan - Episode 5 - Brahma Ji asks Maharishi Valmiki to write the story of Ramayan
"narad muni maharishi valmiki ko ramayan likhne ke lie unko prerit karte hain. narad muni maharishi ko ram katha sunte hain. maharishi valmiki shikari ko shrap dene ki bat se pareshan hote hain.
